standard_prerequisites.name: Augmentations of simplicial spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 525-527: Y is a simplicial space with augmentation a : Y -> X, with component morphisms of topological spaces a_n : Y_n -> X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaves on the simplicial site described componentwise
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 549-552: (1) is used as the definition of a^{-1}F via the componentwise description of sheaves on the simplicial site; (4) is used as the definition of a_*.

standard_prerequisites.name: The component restrictions g_n : Sh(X) -> Sh(Y_n)
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 537-538 and proof lines 552-554: part (3), a g_n = a_n, holds because g_n^{-1} a^{-1} = a_n^{-1} by construction.

core_obligations: Part (2) and the component data (proof lines 546-549): the identity a_m Y(phi) = a_n holds for augmentations of simplicial objects in any category, hence Y(phi)^{-1} a_m^{-1}F = a_n^{-1}F, which defines a Y(phi)-map from a_m^{-1}F to a_n^{-1}F.

Definitions and the morphism-of-topoi requirements (lines 550-557): a^{-1} is defined by (1) using the componentwise description of sheaves on the simplicial site; a_* is defined by (4) as the equalizer of a_{0,*}G_0 -> a_{1,*}G_1; part (3) follows by construction; exactness of a^{-1} is immediate from the exactness of the component inverse images a_n^{-1}.

The adjunction bijection, both directions (lines 560-577): given beta : a^{-1}F -> G, the components beta_n : a_n^{-1}F -> G_n are adjoint to F -> a_{n,*}G_n, and compatibility with the simplicial structure shows beta_0 lands in the equalizer a_*G; conversely, given alpha : F -> a_*G, choosing phi : [0] -> [n] the composite F -> a_*G -> a_{0,*}G_0 ->^{G(phi)} a_{n,*}G_n is adjoint to maps a_n^{-1}F -> G_n which define a morphism of sheaves a^{-1}F -> G (the mutual-inverse verification is omitted; see notes).
Closing observation (lines 584-586): the author remarks that this morphism of topoi does not correspond to any obvious geometric functor between the sites defining the topoi.
proof_roadmap: Define a^{-1} componentwise via the description of sheaves on the simplicial site and a_* as an equalizer.
Check the morphism-of-topoi requirements: adjunction and exactness, the latter immediate from the components.
Build the adjunction bijection in both directions from the component adjunctions and the equalizer description.
difficulty_reason: Construction lemma (statement 523-543, proof 545-587): builds the canonical topos morphism attached to an augmentation - a^{-1} defined through the componentwise description of sheaves, a_* as an equalizer, exactness immediate from the component inverse images, and an explicitly two-sided adjunction bijection assembled from the component adjunctions; the only unverified step is the mutual-inverse check, recorded in the notes. H2: construction assembling component morphisms of topoi.
